description: We manufacture fire-retardant-treated wood cladding for a six-storey sprinklered office required to be noncombustible. Our proposed wall assembly was fire-tested only with unweathered cladding. We want to omit accelerated weathering before the fire-exposure test. The assembly is not one of the prescriptive Appendix D exterior-wall assemblies; our proposal relies on the tested-wall route.
known_facts: wall fire test uses unweathered cladding only
accelerated weathering before fire-exposure test omitted
not an Appendix D prescriptive assembly

should_cite.why: Separate prescriptive assembly route is explicitly excluded by the synthetic facts.
